config.study_status: CPU workflow smoke only; not the scientific long-distance experiment
config.interpretation: Finite-distance periodic numerical evidence; no global existence or physical-validity certificate.

conventions.asymmetry: (power at k>0 minus power at k<0)/total power including zero mode
conventions.recurrence: Same tau origin, global phase fit only; raw complex distance also recorded
conventions.invariants: SpatialDysthe.invariants: action, modified energy and modified momentum for the noncanonical free-surface envelope; not all exactly conserved by the projected ODE
conventions.small_initial_invariant: Relative drift is null if initial invariant is nearly zero; absolute drift remains reported
conventions.physical_indicators: epsilon*peak and epsilon*spectral width/RMS are formal weak-nonlinearity/narrowband indicators, not validated universal physical cutoffs

diagnostics.limitation: Sampled, two-level numerical refinement in periodic boxes; not a rigorous error bound, proof of smoothness/global existence, or validation of Dysthe against the full water-wave equations.

events.interpretation: Interior extrema of sampled traces; no promised recurrence, no continuous event-time accuracy, no translation alignment
